content.description: Validation harness for minibob Testing Infrastructure Development-Deployment-Runtime-Refinement Loop
content.purpose: Validates the closed feedback loop through external observation across 7 phases: deployment state, activity validation, backend records, boredom system, metrics collection, infrastructure visualization, and helmfile orchestration

usage.typescript: import { runValidation } from './tests/validation-harnesses/minibob-testing-infrastructure-harness'; const result = await runValidation({ namespace: 'testing-minibob' });

parameters.namespace: K8s namespace to validate (e.g., testing-minibob, minibob-cluster)
parameters.skipBoredomValidation: Skip boredom system validation (default: true for non-cluster namespaces)

validationPhases.name: Deployment State
validationPhases.description: Validates K8s namespace, pod status, and backend availability via kubectl

validationPhases.name: Activity Validation
validationPhases.description: Executes test-vessel-capabilities.sh and validates test results

validationPhases.name: Backend Records
validationPhases.description: Queries backend API for execution records and metrics

validationPhases.name: Boredom System
validationPhases.description: Validates boredom system configuration and activity via pod logs

validationPhases.name: Metrics Collection
validationPhases.description: Validates local metrics files exist and have valid structure

validationPhases.name: Helmfile Orchestration
validationPhases.description: Validates helmfile state shows multi-namespace releases

returnValue.pass: boolean - overall validation result (true if all non-skipped phases pass)
returnValue.phase1_deploymentState: PhaseResult - namespace and pod status validation
returnValue.phase3_backendRecords: PhaseResult - backend API and execution records validation
returnValue.phase4_boredomSystem: PhaseResult - boredom system configuration and logs validation

validatesRequirements: requirement1_progressiveLayers - via Phase 1 (deployment state) and Phase 7 (helmfile orchestration)
requirement6_closedLoop - via all phases combined (deployment → validation → backend → metrics → boredom)
requirement7_traceability - partial validation via metrics and backend records (git commit SHA traceability is observability enhancement)
